lesson: The system is consistently failing to distinguish between genuine trend reversals and liquidity sweeps, leading to entries during high-volatility mean reversion attempts that ignore the dominant trend. By prioritizing RSI exhaustion and local EMA resistance over the broader market structure, the strategy is repeatedly catching falling knives or fading strong impulses.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 4H timeframe before executing any counter-trend or mean-reversion trade on the 1H/30m charts.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based exhaustion signals less in high-volatility regimes; prioritize SMC order flow over oscillator extremes.
